outcome_intro: Ask which devices across every client never reached an MDM server, which lose AppleCare in the next 90 days, or which returned Macs are still Activation Locked, and get the list. Apple Business plus your AI agent reads a local store per customer org, so questions the portal answers one org and one serial at a time become one answer. It also moves serials between MDM servers, with a --dry-run preview.

instead_of_say.instead: Sign in to each client's Apple Business Manager, filter devices by Unassigned, and check each serial's MDM server by hand
instead_of_say.say: Which devices across my clients never got assigned to an MDM server?

instead_of_say.instead: Check AppleCare coverage one serial at a time before every renewal conversation
instead_of_say.say: Which client devices lose AppleCare in the next 90 days?

instead_of_say.instead: Find out a returned Mac is still Activation Locked when the technician tries to redeploy it
instead_of_say.say: Which devices are still Activation Locked to a user?

pain_points: A new Mac that was never assigned to the right MDM server in Apple Business Manager does not show up for zero-touch enrollment, and the technician finds out at the client's desk (Jamf Community, July 2024: the serial "does not appear in a PreStage Enrollment section").
AppleCare coverage and Activation Lock are per-device lookups, so a fleet-wide view before a renewal or a hardware refresh means checking serials one at a time across every client org.
Every client is a separate Apple Business organization with its own API account, so nothing in the portal rolls them up into one view.

different_vs_wrappers: This skill syncs each customer org's devices and MDM servers into its own local SQLite store, and devices enrich adds AppleCare and Activation Lock per device, so cross-client questions (unassigned devices, expiring coverage, user locks) are one offline query across every org. An MCP server that forwards each tool call to the Apple Business API answers one serial at a time, and AppleCare and Activation Lock are per-device endpoints.
different_vs_vendor: Apple Business Manager stays your place to set default server assignments and manage accounts; Apple offers no AI integration for it. This skill answers the fleet questions across every client's organization in the AI agent you already use, and complements the portal rather than replacing it.

faqs.a: Yes, on paid ChatGPT plans. ChatGPT connects to remote MCP servers over HTTPS, so it needs the Apple Business MCP server's token-protected HTTP mode hosted over HTTPS. Step-by-step in the install guide.

faqs.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faqs.a: No. Paste one sentence into Claude Code or Codex and your agent does the install, or run a one-line installer. You enter your credentials once.

faqs.q: Is my Apple Business data safe?
faqs.a: Your data stays on your machine. The CLI, MCP server, and the local mirror are all local. The AI sees query results, not raw bulk data, and credentials are never bundled or transmitted by MSP Skills.

faqs.q: What do I need from each client's Apple Business Manager?
faqs.a: An API account. An Administrator opens Settings > API in Apple Business, adds an API account and downloads its private key (.pem, offered once). The account's Client ID and Key ID plus that key are the three values the skill needs. API accounts belong to one organization, so each client gets its own.

faqs.q: Will this hit Apple's API rate limits?
faqs.a: It paces itself when Apple Business answers 429. Sync once, then the fleet reports read the local store and make no API calls; devices enrich is the only per-device fan-out, bounded by --concurrency, and --skip-fresh lets a rerun resume.

faqs.q: Does it replace my MDM (Jamf, Intune, Kandji, Mosyle)?
faqs.a: No. Apple Business Manager decides which MDM server a device enrolls with; this skill reads and changes that assignment and reports on the devices. Your MDM still manages them after enrollment.

governance_summary: It reads your Apple Business inventory, MDM servers, AppleCare coverage, Activation Lock, users and audit log, and can create, change and delete Blueprints, Configurations and MDM servers and move devices between MDM servers. Over MCP every write previews and runs only with confirm set to true. Let an agent read freely and preview writes; keep device assignment, deletes and authentication changes with a human.
